items.source: This interface describes the API for enhancing a given Query. Query enhancers understand the syntax of the query and can introspect queries to determine aliases and projections. Enhancers can also rewrite queries to apply sorting and create count queries if the underlying query is a SELECT query.
items.translation: 该接口描述了用于增强给定查询的 API。查询增强器能够理解查询语法，并可对查询进行内省以确定别名和投影。此外，增强器还可以重写查询以应用排序操作，并在底层查询为 SELECT 查询时创建计数查询。
